title: Cloud Storage Incident Response
description: Cloud storage incidents affecting research data access
immediate_actions: Assess impact on research operations and data access
Implement alternative storage access if available
Contact research team for data access needs
investigation_steps: Review cloud storage service logs and status
Check storage array health and connectivity
Verify network connectivity to cloud storage
resolution_steps: Restart cloud storage services following standard procedures
Implement storage array fixes if needed
Apply storage system patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with cloud storage vendor for complex issues
verification: Verify research data access and retrieval
Confirm with research staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Do not delete research data during troubleshooting
Suspected data exposure must immediately involve the security team
Research data is valuable and must be preserved
Coordinate with research team for minimal disruption to data access
